
LIST-CHECKPOINTS
List all checkpoints for a work unit, showing both automatic and manual checkpoints with visual indicators (🤖 automatic, 📌 manual). Displays checkpoint names, types, and creation timestamps.

WHEN TO USE
  Use before restoring a checkpoint to see what's available, to verify a checkpoint was created successfully, to see the history of checkpoints for a work unit, to decide which old checkpoints to cleanup, or to understand automatic vs manual checkpoint patterns.

PREREQUISITES
  • Work unit must exist
  • Git repository must be initialized

USAGE
  fspec list-checkpoints <workUnitId>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    The ID of the work unit to list checkpoints for (e.g., AUTH-001, UI-002)

OPTIONS
  No options available

TYPICAL WORKFLOW
  Create checkpoints: fspec checkpoint AUTH-001 baseline,List checkpoints: fspec list-checkpoints AUTH-001,Choose checkpoint: See available names and timestamps,Restore: fspec restore-checkpoint AUTH-001 baseline,Or cleanup: fspec cleanup-checkpoints AUTH-001 --keep-last 5

EXAMPLES
  1. List all checkpoints for work unit
  $ fspec list-checkpoints AUTH-001
  Checkpoints for AUTH-001:

📌  before-refactor (manual)
   Created: 2025-10-21T14:30:00.000Z

📌  baseline (manual)
   Created: 2025-10-21T13:15:00.000Z

🤖  AUTH-001-auto-testing (automatic)
   Created: 2025-10-21T10:00:00.000Z

  2. List checkpoints for work unit with no checkpoints
  $ fspec list-checkpoints UI-002
  No checkpoints found for UI-002

COMMON ERRORS
  ✗ Work unit 'AUTH-001' does not exist
    Fix: undefined

  ✗ No checkpoints found for <workUnitId>
    Fix: undefined

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec fspec checkpoint - Create manual checkpoint
  fspec fspec restore-checkpoint - Restore a checkpoint
  fspec fspec cleanup-checkpoints - Delete old checkpoints
  fspec fspec update-work-unit-status - Auto-creates checkpoints

NOTES
  • All checkpoints are shown by default (both automatic and manual)
  • Checkpoints are sorted by creation time (newest first)
  • Automatic checkpoints use naming pattern: {workUnitId}-auto-{state}
  • Manual checkpoints use user-provided names
  • No pagination - all checkpoints for work unit are displayed
  • Empty list is not an error - just means no checkpoints exist yet
